content:
elaine: Quick heads-up 1: Hosted API update rolling to GA next Tue: new opt-in low-latency path 'fast-path', tightened tool-call defaults, and a fallback playbook. This thread is the short cross-team sync.

omar: Can we get exact rollout window + canary targets?

elaine: Canary tonight 21:00 PT -> 5% us-west-2, expand to 25% across US after healthy checks. If P95 latency > 150ms or error rate > 1% we auto-pause and revert.

deploy-bot: Canary kicked off at 1901009400. job=fastpath-canary-221, health=monitoring.

ross: Ops checklist: add synthetic that measures stream-first-byte, kv-cache-hit, and fallback.invoked. Pager if fallback.invoked > 0.6% for 5m.

amy: Support note: we need canned replies for "why am I getting 429s when calling tools" and "how to opt into fast-path". Draft will link to docs.

elaine: API surface: POST /v2/fast-path/stream. Opt-in with header `X-Redwood-Fast: 1`. Example:
```http
POST /v2/fast-path/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Redwood-Fast: 1
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "mosaicx-fast-1", "input": "Short summary", "max_tokens": 128 }
```

omar: Rate limits: tool-calls default tightened to 15/min per-tool per-key on Hosted. Dedicated customers can request changes via support.

infra-bot: Config flag fast_path_ga toggled true in staging at 1901008700.

ross: Client guidance: use shorter timeouts (1.5x expected), exponential backoff with jitter for 429/503, honor `X-Tool-Rate-Limit` and `X-Tool-Rate-Remaining` response headers.

amy: Docs PR created -> internal link. Will add migration FAQ and KB. ETA merge Mon EOD.

elaine: Thanks. Marketing will draft the GA note for Tue 10:00 PT. If legal or product has concerns about wording (no latency SLA), ping me. I'll post final links here once live. :rocket:
